question: **It was previously thought that ‘children seemed to have very little effect from this disease’. ‘This disease’ refers to:**
solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. 'Covid-19.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• The theme of the passage is that "many children in New York were suffering from uncommon inflammatory condition that may be related to COVID-19" which is mentioned in the very first line of the first paragraph.
 
• Here, ‘children seemed to have very little effect from this disease’ is taken from the first sentence of the last paragraph. Also, the inflammatory diseases connected with Covid-19 was mentioned several time.
 
• Therefore from the above sentence, we can certainly say that here **'this disease'** is Covid-19.
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 3.
